title: athyrium conilii var. oldhamii
intro: Athyrium conilii var. oldhamii, commonly known as the Lady Fern, is a species of fern native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lady Fern include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium conilii var. oldhamii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
